title: Easy Italian Sausage Spaghetti
description: This Italian sausage spaghetti is an easy and tasty version of spaghetti and meatballs without the hassle of making meatballs.
ingredients: 1 (6 ounce) can sliced black olives, drained
1 teaspoon dried oregano, or to taste
1 teaspoon dried basil, or to taste
1 (16 ounce) package spaghetti, or as needed
0.25 cup grated Parmesan cheese, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir sausage, mushrooms, onion, green bell pepper, and garlic in hot oil until sausage is browned and crumbly, about 20 minutes; drain and discard grease.
Stir tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, and olives into sausage mixture; season with oregano, basil, and salt. Simmer mixture until flavors infuse, about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain.
Transfer spaghetti to a serving bowl. Top with tomato-sausage sauce and Parmesan cheese.
